evidence: We deploy AI and other emerging technologies in various facets of our operations and we continue to explore further use cases for AI.

Our Digital Solutions include artificial intelligence medical device software, such as aPROMISE and Automated Bone Scan Index, both of which are FDA cleared and received a European Conformity Marking.
Digital Solutions are designed to enhance imaging value and the throughput, reproducibility and reliability of image analysis, as well as to inform treatment selection and response to therapy.
in some cases, we also obtain clinical imaging data that we may use to further develop artificial intelligence solutions
ai_positioning.summary: LNTH intègre l'IA dans ses solutions d'imagerie médicale (logiciels FDA-cleared comme aPROMISE) pour améliorer l'analyse d'images et l'aide à la décision thérapeutique, tout en reconnaissant les risques concurrentiels et réglementaires associés.
